maddeler.e:
استلذا (form X)
# اِسْتَلَذَّا (istalaḏḏā) /is.ta.lað.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# اُسْتُلِذَّا (ustuliḏḏā) /us.tu.lið.ðaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
# اِسْتَلِذَّا (istaliḏḏā) /is.ta.lið.ðaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَلَذَّ (istalaḏḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
